collection.description: A broken bridge isolates the fruit groves.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A broken bridge isolates the fruit groves.

choices.label: Train living vines across the gap.
Attempt to lift stones with magic.
Ask elders to restore the old stepping path.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The vines eventually form a strong crossing.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The vines grow too slowly for this harvest.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Cutting timber leaves a nearby slope exposed.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The stones settle into a sturdy foundation.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A lifted stone falls harmlessly into the river, ending the attempt.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The familiar route serves careful travelers.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: A sudden rise in water makes the path unsafe.
